fixtureDisclosure: Four controlled suites use the live player-semantic report shape. Each suite contains five preset battles; they are not claimed as fresh combat simulation.

checks.statement: Objective contribution and relative-strength evidence must not change with player profile.
The three scales should produce visible high-end distinctions while sharing objective evidence.
At 65% domain magnitude, only the expert scale should reach the shared level-3 trait gate.
Moving an unchanged character-history later in the campaign must not weaken its first impression.
Analogous replacement characters must never share observations or knowledge rows.
All strength and trait knowledge evidence for replacement characters must remain inside that subject's own reports.
Trait revalidation may preserve finite order effects, but all 120 orders must finish within one shared semantic band per subject-domain.
Repeated contradictory evidence must reduce the general belief while exact-context weakness remains retrievable.
All 120 orders should show bounded primacy; order may move the final result by at most one shared semantic band in these mixed-evidence suites.
The same 200 useful contribution must retain subject-visible teammate environment and decomposable team-performance evidence.
One battle must solve all four character positions simultaneously instead of updating them in sequence.
The weakest member of the live top 30% is zero: several strong arrivals lower old labels, while many valid weak arrivals raise them.
Negative deterioration still uses one provisional scale for all three players and is not yet calibrated.
Existing trait cognition must be reviewed every battle: a clear weak attempt creates an environmental correction, while no attempt leaves belief unchanged.

noAttemptActions.subject: Ember Mage
noAttemptActions.reason: no visible domain attempt in this battle

contextual_correction.purpose: Strong first impression, exact-context correction, repeated counterevidence, and rebound.

profile_trait_resolution.purpose: Near-threshold role signals test the three perception scales without changing objective evidence.

roster_replacement_identity.purpose: Late roster entry and analogous replacements must form separate, subject-local impressions.

team_relative_confounding.purpose: Hold one character's objective output fixed while changing teammate output.

current.primacyRule: observation weight = evidence reliability * (1 + 1 / subject observation order)
